name: Athens Capital Center Hotel
positioning: Athens Capital Hotel - MGallery, an art-filled hotel on Syntagma Square opposite the Parliament House, with a rooftop infinity pool bar looking toward the Acropolis
best_for: Travelers who want a central base on Syntagma Square within walking distance of Plaka
Art lovers drawn to a hotel built around a monumental sculpture installation

facts.text: Athens Capital Hotel was the first MGallery Collection hotel in Greece.
The hotel is on Syntagma Square, opposite the Parliament House.
The hotel is next to the Plaka neighbourhood and close to Monastiraki and its traditional flea market.
The hotel is a few steps from Voukourestiou Street, home to famous boutiques.
Mappemonde, a work by Greek sculptor Georgios Lappas, is installed in the hotel's atrium, beginning on the tenth floor and running through all floors.
Rooms feature Grecian marble, soft colors and Signature Artworks.
A Deluxe Room category comes with a king-size bed and a private balcony overlooking the city skyline.
The hotel celebrates Greek women who shaped history, with a sculpture of the goddess Dimitra and suites dedicated to them.
MFlavours restaurant serves Mediterranean cuisine and has an interactive open kitchen.
The hotel welcomes guests with pets.

highlights.text: Mappemonde is a rooftop infinity pool bar with views of the Acropolis and Lycabettus Hill.
Georgios Lappas's Mappemonde sculpture installation runs from the tenth floor down through the hotel's atrium.
The Presidential Suite opens to a view of Lycabettus Hill and has a walk-in closet, a bathtub and a terrace.
The hotel's M Moment is Greek komboloi storytelling followed by traditional Greek mezze.

considerations.text: This is a city-centre base on Syntagma Square, opposite the Parliament House, in the heart of Athens.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may lack traditional Greek charm.
